perks.name: Nightmarish Power
perks.description: Final blows to a challenging combatant or higher-ranked target grant Unstable Essence. When you have Unstable Essence, you receive grenade and melee stat bonuses.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring an Elite+ Kill:
Grants Unstable Essence for 15 seconds.
Scoring additional Elite+ Kills refresh the buff duration.

Unstable Essence | +30 Melee Stat and +30 Grenade Stat.

perks.name: Nightmarish Resilience
perks.description: When you have Unstable Essence, rapid weapon damage or final blows heal you and begin health regeneration.
perks.exact:
While Unstable Essence is active:
Upon scoring a total of 8 weapon damage instances within 3 seconds of each, counted up to once every 0.45 seconds: 
Begins Critical Health Regeneration and restores 20 HP.
Incurs a 2 second cooldown upon triggering before hits count again. 
Perk takes AT LEAST 3.6 seconds to initially trigger, then 5.6 seconds for the next reactivation assuming nonstop damage.

perks.name: Ionic Overclock
perks.description: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
perks.exact:
While Amplified:
(Linear) Fusion Rifles and Heat Weapons are granted +? Handling and +? Reload Speed.

perks.name: Shock and Clear
perks.description: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Jolt Kill or a Jolted Enemy Kill:
Creates an Ionic Trace.

perks.name: Rapid Repair
perks.description: When your shields begin to regenerate, you gain flinch resistance and damage resistance for a short time.
perks.exact:
Upon healing Shield HP:
 10% [2.5%] Damage Resist (Resist x1) and ?% Flinch Resist for 7 seconds.
Can only trigger once per Full Heal.

perks.name: Built from Scratch
perks.description: While your reserves are low, combatant final blows with weapons provide additional ammo progress based on their ammo type.  Primary ammo weapons boost Special ammo progress, and Special ammo weapons boost Heavy ammo progress.
perks.exact:
Combatant Kills grant additional Ammo Progress based on their Ammo Type if Ammo Reserves are low.

Primary Ammo Weapons grant +3% Special Ammo Progress while Special Ammo Reserves <20%.
Special Ammo Weapons receive +2% Heavy Ammo Progress while Heavy Ammo Reserves <20%.

perks.name: Well Prepared
perks.description: Picking up ammo grants Armor Charge. Grants a bonus to Health stat per Armor Charge you have.
perks.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup: 
Grants a stack of Armor Charge.

Each Armor Charge stack grants +10 Health Stat.
Grants up to +30 Health Stat with x3 Armor Charge.
Maxes out at +60 Health Stat with x6 Armor Charges.

perks.name: Down the Line
perks.description: Sustained damage on minibosses, Champions, and bosses increases weapon damage versus base and powerful combatants. Weapon final blows consume one stack each.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a hit against Miniboss+ Combatants:
Grants a stack of Down the Line, up to a maximum of 10 stacks. 
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between gaining stacks.

Down the Line:
15% increased Weapon Damage against Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants.
Consumes a stack upon killing Rank-and-File and Elite Combatants.

perks.name: Combat Meditation
perks.description: Sword hits return grenade and class energy. Bonus energy is granted if Blade Focus is active.
perks.exact:
On Sword Hit:
3% Grenade and Class Ability Energy.

perks.name: Blade Focus
perks.description: Briefly guard with a Sword to ready Blade Focus. While Blade Focus is readied, hitting a target with your sword increases Sword damage and lunge distance for a moderate duration.
perks.exact:
Upon guarding for 1.35 seconds:
Grants Blade Focus Ready for 1 second.
 Swinging while it is active AND scoring a hit consumes Blade Focus Ready to grant Blade Focus for 7 seconds.

Blade Focus:
10% Increased Sword Damage and 100% Increased Sword Lunge Distance
Combat Meditation Energy Gains are increased to 8% Grenade and Class Ability Energy.
Blade Focus is removed upon guarding or stowing the sword.

perks.name: Opening Act
perks.description: Final blows with grenades grant Heat weapons bonus stability and vent speed and grant Primary ammo weapons bonus stability and reload speed.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Grenade Kill:
Grants Opening Act for 15 seconds.

Opening Act | +? Stability and +? Vent Speed to Heat Weapons. Primary Weapons are instead granted +? Stability and +? Reload Speed.

perks.name: Room Clearing
perks.description: Multiple final blows with Heat weapons or Primary ammo weapons grant bonuses to weapon and grenade stats and increased ammo generation for Heat weapons and Primary ammo weapons.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 3 Heat Weapons or Primary Weapon Kills within 4 seconds of each:
Grants Room Cleaning for 10 seconds.

Room Cleaning | +40 Grenade and +40 Weapons. Additionally, it grants +40 Ammo Generation for Heat Weapons and Primary Ammo Weapons.

perks.name: Primary Honing
perks.description: Increases handling and reload speed for Primary ammo weapons. Primary ammo weapons gain increased damage against non-boss combatants based on your Weapons stat.
perks.exact:
+15 Handling and 0.9x Reload Duration Multiplier for Primary Weapons.

Increased Primary Weapon Damage against Non-Boss Combatants based on the Weapons stat.

Compared to the damage dealt at the equivalent Weapons Stat:
20 Stat = 0.6% | 40 = 1.2% | 60 = 1.8% | 80 = 2.4% | 100 = 3%
120 = 4.75% | 140 = 6.6% | 160 = 8.35% | 180 = 10.2% | 200 = 12%

perks.name: Supercyclical
perks.description: Final blows while your Super is active refund Super energy when it ends.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring kills while in a Super Ability:
x1 = ~5?% | x2 = ?% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?% | x5 = ?% | x6 = ~33% Super Ability Energy once it ends.

Upon scoring kills with Super Damage while NOT in a Super Ability:
x1 = ~5?% | x2 = ?% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?% | x5 = ?% | x6 = ~33% Super Ability Energy.

Super Ability Refund Cap is reset on Super Ability Cast or upon swaping off of Supercyclical and then reacquiring the 4 Piece Perk by changing gear.

perks.name: Sinew Stitching
perks.description: Taking damage from combatants sometimes spawns a Threadling.

Upon receiving ? damage from Combatants or upon reaching Critical Health:
Spawns a Threadling.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown between Threadling spawns from damage and a 5 second cooldown between Threadlings spawns from reaching Critical Health.

perks.name: Knit Together
perks.description: For a short time after your shields break, your next several Threadling hits restore health.
perks.exact:
Upon reaching Critical Health:
The next 3 Threadling hits within 10 seconds of reaching Critical Health restore 50? HP.
Incurs a 5 second cooldown afterwards.

perks.name: Augmented Armaments
perks.description: Primary ammo weapons deal increased damage to disoriented combatants.
perks.exact:
Primary Ammo Weapons deal 15% increased damage against Disoriented Combatants.
Disorient Duration is shorter than the animation, generally lasting for ~2.7 seconds.
Does NOT work with Arc Blind.

perks.name: Augmented Explosives
perks.description: Your grenade abilities release an additional disorienting pulse shortly after detonating.
perks.exact:
On Grenade Ability Detonation: 
Disorients enemies within 10 meters for 2.7 seconds.
Does not work on Grapple. 
Does not work on Young Ahamkara Spine's Tripmines.

perks.name: Regenerative Threshold
perks.description: Performing a finisher stores power. The next time your shields are broken, consume stored power to immediately heal and start health regeneration.
perks.exact:
On Finisher:
Grants Regenerative Threshold.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Consumes Regenerative Threshold.
Restores 20 HP and begins Health Regeneration.

perks.name: Melee Conduction
perks.description: While you have Radiant, Restoration, or Cure, your melee hits release a burst that will scorch the target.

While Cure, Radiant, or Restoration are active:
Melee and Glaive Hits trigger a Solar Burst on the target, dealing 28 [17] Damage and inflicting x20+10 Scorch within 7 meters.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown per trigger.
Will NOT trigger if the Melee Hit granted a Solar Buff, such as Ember of Torches, unless the Melee Ability intrinsically inflicts Scorch. (Exotics do NOT count)

perks.name: Force Absorption

perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Missile, Rocket Launcher or Grenade Launcher Kill:
20% Area-of-Effect Damage Resist and 60% Explosive Self-Damage Resist for 15 seconds.

Missiles:
Quicksilver Storm's Rocket Tracer, Nanotech Tracer Round, Exhaustive Research Rockets, Rocket Frames, Grand Overture Missiles, and Hazardous Propulsion's Exodus Rockets.

perks.name: Reactive Shock
perks.description: When Force Absorption is active, taking melee damage causes you to emit a disorienting burst once.
perks.exact:
While Force Absorption is active:
Being hit by a Melee Attack triggers a Disorienting Burst, disorienting enemies within ? meters for ? seconds.
Can only trigger once per Reactive Shock activation.

perks.name: Photogalvanic
perks.description: Receiving healing temporarily grants your Solar weapons increased flinch resistance, handling, and reload speed.
perks.exact:
Upon receiving ANY healing while not at Full HP:
+20? Handling, +10 Reload Speed, 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier, and ?% Flinch Resist for Solar Weapons for 4 seconds.
Works with ANY source of healing, such as Orb Pickups. Restoration constantly refreshes it

perks.name: Cauterize
perks.description: Rapid Solar final blows heal you.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 3 Solar Kills within 3? seconds of each:
Restores 30 HP.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between heals.

Damaging a target with a Sword, Glaive, or any melee attack exhausts them. 

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.
perks.exact:
Upon damaging an enemy with a Sword, Glaive, or Melee Attack:
Inflicts Exhaustion for 5 seconds, reducing Combatant Damage Output by 25%.

perks.name: Stesso Tempo
perks.description: Blocking attacks with a Sword or Glaive grants a short period of damage resistance against targets when you next drop your guard.
perks.exact:
Upon blocking damage with a Glaive or a Sword:
50% [10%] Damage Resist (Resist x4) for 3 seconds upon no longer guarding. 
Damage Resist can be reset by blocking and dropping the guard before buff expires.

perks.name: Resonant Plating
perks.description: Your health begins regenerating immediately after taking melee damage from a powerful combatant.
perks.exact:
Upon receiving a Melee Attack from a Miniboss+ Combatant:
Begins Health Regeneration.

perks.name: Siphoning Touch
perks.description: Gain stacks of Siphoning Touch for weapon or Glaive melee hits. Switching weapons heals you and consumes all stacks.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring weapon damage instances or a Glaive Melee Attack:
Grants a stack of Siphoning Touch, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
x1 = ~26.7% of Mag | x2 = ~53.4% | x3 = ~80% | x4 = ~106% | x5 = ~133%
Scorch does not count for damage instances. Always rounds down.

On Weapon Stow:
Consumes all Siphoning Touch to restores HP, based on the stack amount.
30 | 60 | 90 | 105 | 120 HP restored.

perks.name: Bad Dreams
perks.description: Final blows versus subclass-debuffed targets have an escalating chance to spawn an Orb of Power.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 3 Elementally-Debuffed Enemy Kills:
Spawns an Orb of Power that grants ?% Super Energy.
No cooldown between Orbs?

perks.name: Dream-Devourer
perks.description: Performing a finisher versus a powerful combatant grants Devour. While you have Devour, gain damage resistance versus combatants.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Devour for 6+3 seconds.

While Devour is active:
20?% Damage Resist against Combatants.

perks.name: Emergency Electromagnet
perks.description: When your shields become broken, collect all nearby Orbs of Power and ammo bricks.
perks.exact:
Upon reaching Critical Health:
Picks up Ammo Bricks and Orbs of Power within 10? meters.
Picking up multiple Orbs of Power will count as simultaneous gains for the Repurposed Charges.

perks.name: Repurposed Charge
perks.description:
Whenever you gain, lose, or spend an Armor Charge, heal and gain damage reduction for a short time.

This effect scales with the amount of Armor Charge gained, lost, or spent.
perks.exact:
Gaining, losing, or consuming Armor Charges restores 5? HP and grants stacks of Repurposed Charge.

Repurposed Charge stacks are based on the amount of simultaneously(!) gained/lost/consumed Armor charges + 1.
Maxes out at x7 with 6 Armor Charges simultaneously lost/spent through Kickstart or Finisher Mods.

Initial Buff duration as well as Buff Extensions are equal to (3 seconds X Repurposed Charge Stacks gained/lost/consumed)
 Buff can be extended to a maximum of 30 seconds, maintaining the highest stack.
Examples: Orb Pickups grant x2 (13% DR) for +6 seconds.
 Special Finisher will grant x4 (29.5% DR) for +12 seconds. Picking up an Orb afterwards will maintain x4 stacks and add +6 seconds.

Repurposed Charge:
Grant Damage Resist per Repurposed Charge stack, up to 35% [?%] DR at 7 stacks.
x1 = 0% [0%] | x2 = 13% [?%] | x3 = 21% [?%] | x4 = 29.5% [?%] | x5 = 31% [?%] | x6 = 33% [?%] | x7 = 35% [?%]

perks.name: Ride Together, Die Together
perks.description: When you pick up an Orb of Power, gain a brief period of rapidly decaying damage reduction.
perks.exact:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Ride Together, Die Together for 3 seconds.
Ride Together, Die Together initially grants 40% [5%] Damage Resist.
Damage Resist scales down to ~30?% with 1.5 seconds left, further reduced to 24?% with 1 second left, decreasing down to 0% over the remaining second.

perks.name: Too Old for This
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant with a finisher grants you Special ammo progress and replenishes a small amount of health.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Finisher:
Restores 32 HP and +16% Special Ammo Progress.

perks.name: Radiolaria Breach
perks.description: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
perks.exact:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Radiolaria Breach.
Can only trigger once per Full Heal.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Consumes Radiolaria Breach to trigger an explosion that deals up to 360 [11] Damage over 7 meters.
+50 Health Stat for 7.5 seconds and releases 4 Radiolaria Pools 5 meters away from the user.
Radiolaria Pools deal 14 Arc Damage every 0.5 seconds.

perks.name: Collective Power
perks.description: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 5 damage instances while any Elemental Buff is active:
Spawns an Orb of Power on the user that grants 0.8?% Super Energy.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orb where additional damage instances will not count.
Only counts a hit up to once every 0.8s, meaning the perk takes AT LEAST 4 seconds to trigger. 
Consecutive triggers take a minimum of 5 seconds to reproc.

Damage Instances dealt to Immune Enemies count towards spawning Orbs.

Elemental Buffs:
Amplified, Bolt Charge | Cure, Radiant, Restoration | Devour, Invisibility, Overshield
Frost Armor | Woven Mail
And also standing in a Healing Rift for no reason

perks.name: Fanfare
perks.description: Gain increased reload speed for the bottom half of your equipped weapon's magazine.
perks.exact:
While Ammo = ≤50% of Magazine AND Ammo ≠ 0:
+15 Reload Speed and 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier.

Does not trigger at 0 Ammo. rip bows, GLs, and Rockets

perks.name: Suros Harmony
perks.description: Reloading a weapon grants it a bonus to handling and reduces incoming flinch for a short time. Weapons with the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait are granted increased range instead.
perks.exact:
Upon finishing a reload:
SUROS Harmony | +30? Handling and ?% Flinch Resist for 6 seconds.
Weapons that have the SUROS Synergy Origin Trait equipped, as well as SUROS Regime are additionally granted +15 Range. 
For some reason, the +Range benefit's timer begins only once you are able to shoot in the reload animation instead of when the ammo is refilled.

SUROS Harmony persists through stow, but only on the weapon that it was triggered on. 
Can be refreshed by retriggering the buff unless it is a SUROS Weapon lmao.

perks.name: Taken Barrier
perks.description: Grenade final blows temporarily reduce incoming damage.
perks.exact:
On Grenade Kill:
Resist x1 (10% [2.5%] DR) for 7 seconds.

perks.name: Taken Armaments
perks.description: Grenade final blows grant additional Heavy ammo progress.
perks.exact:
On Grenade Kill:
+10% Heavy Ammo Progress.

perks.name: Queensfoil Rush
perks.description: Gain a powerful overshield while performing your finisher. When you finish a target, release a slowing burst around you.
perks.exact:
Finishers grant a 200? HP Overshield for the duration of the finisher (+0.3s).

On Finisher:
Inflicts x? Slow to enemies within 7 meters.

perks.name: Truth to Power
perks.description: Gain increasing damage resistance when you deal damage or land final blows. Finishers grant accelerated progress. At max stacks, the recharge rate of your abilities is also increased.
perks.exact:
Each damage instance scored grants a stack of Truth, up to a maximum of x999 stacks. wherein it gets renamed to Power.
Kills and Finishers grant many more stacks, although it seems to have different gains depending on the stack amount.
Kills tend to be within 20-35 stacks. Finishers tend to give around 60-90 stacks. 
ALL stacks are removed on death.

Truth grants Damage Resist per stack, up to 15% DR at maximum.
250 = 3.75% | 500 = 7.5% | 750 = 10% | 999 = 15% Damage Resist

Truth to Power Effect at x999 stacks:
+50% Additional Base Grenade, and Melee Regeneration Rate.
+35% Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
15% Damage Resist.

perks.name: Untold Greed
perks.description: Picking up ammo, Orbs of Power, Elemental pickups, or destroying a Strand Tangle grants stacks of Untold Greed, slightly reducing damage taken and providing reload speed to equipped weapons. When your shields are broken, some stacks are lost.
perks.exact:
Upon picking up an Ammo Brick, an Orb of Power, on Elemental Pickup, or destroying a Tangle:
Grants a stack of Untold Greed, up to a maximum of 100 stacks.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Removes 10 stacks.

Untold Greed:
Up to +? Reload Speed and 15% Damage Resist at x25 stacks.
x5 = 6% DR | x10 = 9% DR | x15 = 11% DR | x20 = 13% DR | x25+ = 15% DR

perks.name: Overflowing Coffers
perks.description: While you have stacks of Untold Greed, Orbs of Power and Elemental pickups provide more of their respective energy, and Strand Tangles deal increased damage. When your shields are broken, all stacks are converted into a fountain of Orbs of Power.
perks.exact:
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<<

While at x5 Untold Greed or higher:
Elemental Pickups are massively improved.
No discernible effect on Orbs of Power.

Firesprites (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Grenade Energy

Void Breaches (+120%) | 11.25% -> 25% Class Energy

Consumes ALL STACKS to spawn 4 Orbs of Power that each grant ~3.15% Super Energy.

Looking upwards/downwards does not affect where the Orbs go.
Allied Guardians get the Orbs, too.

perks.name: Old Martian Diplomacy
perks.description: Stowing a weapon after defeating a powerful combatant or a Guardian heals you a small amount and disorients nearby combatants.
perks.exact:
On Weapon Stow after scoring an Elite+ or Guardian Weapon Kill:
Restores 40? HP and disorients Combatants within 12 meters.
Incurs a 2? second cooldown between activations

perks.name: High Noon
perks.description: Freshly drawn weapons deal increased precision damage to combatants for a short period. Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait equipped or Exotics manufactured by the Tex Mechanica Foundry gain further increased benefits.
perks.exact:
Upon readying a weapon:
7% Increased Weakspot Damage against Combatants for 4 seconds.
Buffs "Precision Hits" against Shielded Combatants and works on weapons without Precision Multipliers as long as they hit the weakspot.
Weakspot Buffs do not work on a Divinity Bubble

Bonus is doubled to 14% Increased Weakspot Damage for the following:
Weapons with the Tex Balanced Stock Origin Trait and Tex Mechanica Exotics.
Dead Man's Tale | Huckleberry | Last Word | Tarrabah | Chaperone | Prospector

perks.exact:
On Ammo Brick Pickup:
Grants stacks of Accretion, up to a maximum of 20 stacks. Stacks persist until death.
Special Ammo Bricks grant 1 stack of Accretion. Heavy Ammo Bricks grant 3 stacks of Accretion.

Accretion:
Grants a Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier per stack, up to a maximum of 0.8x Ready/Stow Animation Duration at 20 stacks.

perks.exact:
Solar Buffs applied to the user and Strand Debuffs inflicted to enemies last 50% longer.
Equipping Ember of Solace or Thread of Continuity results in the effects lasting 70% longer.

perks.name: Stable Resonance
perks.description: Defeating a powerful combatant generates Stable Resonance, which grants damage resistance and increased weapon damage for the duration.
perks.exact:
On Elite+ Kill:
7% Increased Weapon Damage and Resist x2 (25% DR) for 12 seconds.

perks.name: Resonance Redirection
perks.description: While you have Stable Resonance, continued weapon damage occasionally generates a resonance burst that damages and exhausts targets.
perks.exact:
While Stable Resonance is active:
Dealing 600? Weapon Damage within ? seconds of each triggers an Exhausting Blast, centered on the enemy.
Incurs an 2? second cooldown between Exhausting Blasts.

Exhausting Blast deals ? Damage and inflicts Exhaust over 8 meters, reducing Combatant Damage Output by 25%.

perks.name: Cursed Fist
perks.description: Melee final blows trigger a Cursed Thrall explosion.
perks.exact:
On Melee Kill:
Causes the enemy to explode, dealing up to ? [?] Arc? Damage over a 4.5 metre radius.
Glaive Melees also trigger it.
Incurs a 0.5? second cooldown between triggers.

Power of the Son x1 | 15% Damage Resist against Combatants and ?% Flinch Resist.
Power of the Son x2 | 25% Damage Resist against Combatants and ?% Flinch Resist.

perks.exact:

+12% Special and +7.5% Heavy Ammo Progress.

Invisibility for 6+? seconds.

perks.exact:

+? Handling and +? Reload Speed.

+? Health Stat while an allied Network Admin is within 15m.

?% Melee Energy for the user and their allies within ? meters.

perks.name: Power Loader

 Dealing Additional Weapon Damage refreshes the buff duration.

On Finisher or Ally Revival:
Initiates a Ceremony for 30 seconds.

+30 Super Stat.

On Orb of Power Pickup:
Extends the Ceremony duration to 30 seconds.

Attaches to enemies or surfaces, initially exploding after 1.2 seconds of being attached, followed by a secondary explosion after 0.6 seconds.

Each explosion deals up to 472 [75] damage over 5 meters on detonation.

Deals up to 946 [150] damage with both explosions.

1225978592.name: Grapple
1225978592.description:
Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.
1225978592.exact:
Hooks up to 22 metres away, dealing 38 [?] damage and staggering enemies on impact, as well as attaching to enemies or objects.
Cancelling a Grapple within 1 second of activation refunds 50% Grenade Energy.

Upon Grappling a Tangle or Grapple Tangle:
Fully refunds a Grapple Ability Charge and grants Grapple Returned for 4 seconds, allowing immediate reactivation if Grappling ends while the buff is active.
Grenade Kickstart does not activate when grappling a Tangle or Grapple Tangle.

Grapple Melee:
Performed by pressing [Melee Attack] while grappling, or for up to ? seconds after, while at a sufficiently fast speed.
Deals 432 [61] impact damage, and up to 432 [61] radial damage over a 4? metre radius, unraveling and pushing enemies back.
Guardians directly hit by Grapple Melee have their Melee Lunge disabled for 0.5 seconds

Grapple Melee counts as both a Grenade and Melee Ability.
Ashes to Assets grants 50% less Super Energy when a Grapple Melee is used with a Grapple Tangle.

Grapple Passive Ability Regeneration is disabled until no longer airborne. Also applies to Silkstrike.

2842514288.name: Swarm Grenade
2842514288.description: A grenade that detonates on impact, releasing multiple drones that seek nearby targets. Each drone slightly scorches affected targets.
2842514288.exact:
Medium Trajectory | Seekers

Releases 9 seeking drones on impact.
Drones begin chasing enemies that come within 7 metres, exploding on contact, otherwise self-destructing after 10-11 seconds.

Each drone deals 58 + 54 [8 + 8] damage and inflicts x5+3 Scorch.

Deals up to 1,008 [144] damage and inflicts x45+27 Scorch with all 9 drones.

3897682694.name: Arcbolt Grenade
3897682694.description: A grenade that chains bolts of lightning to nearby targets.
3897682694.exact:
Heavy Trajectory | Scan

Scans and targets the closest enemy in Line of Sight within 12 meters upon impact, releasing Arc Lightning towards them after 1 second.
After dealing damage, it chains to the closest enemy within 10 meters that hasn't been hit by Arc Lightning, repeating until it has damaged a maximum of 4 enemies.

Arc Lightning deals 521 [85] damage.

4051767608.name: Duskfield Grenade
4051767608.description: A grenade that shatters on impact, leaving behind a field that slows targets and freezes those who do not leave the volume.
4051767608.exact:
Medium Trajectory | DoT Field

Detonates on impact, dealing up to 20 [20] damage and inflicting x20 [x10] Slow Stacks for 2+2 seconds in a ? meter radius, as well as creating a Slowing Field.

Slowing Field:
Deals 1 damage and applies x10 [x5] Slow Stacks for 2+2 seconds every 0.35 [0.3] seconds for 7+2 seconds in a 4 meter radius.

2370269384.name: Silkstrike
2370269384.description:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.
2370269384.exact:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [45%]
Base Duration: 24.5 seconds, or 4% Super Drain per Second

Light Attack
Drains 4% Super Energy.
Hits deal 1638 [260] damage.
Kills cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to 1293 [?] damage to enemies within ? metres.

Heavy Attack
Drains 9% Super Energy.
Swings the rope dart in a 360-degree arc, dealing [504] [80] damage in a ? metre radius. Hits twice per usage.

Grenade
Does not drain Super Energy.
Functionally identical to a Grapple Grenade that instantly recharges once grounded.

Class Ability
Drains 4.5% Super Energy.
Performs the Arc Staff Dodge Animation, evading attacks.

 Allows the repeated usage of Ensnaring Slam while the Aspect is equipped at the cost of 4.5% Super Energy.

2370269388.name: Storm's Edge
2370269388.description:
Summon an electrified dagger and throw it in your aim direction.

When the dagger hits a surface or a target, you blink to its location and perform a powerful whirling strike, damaging any nearby targets. Can be reactivated after the strike to perform additional throws.

If the dagger flies for long enough without impacting anything, it detonates and you blink to the detonation location.
2370269388.exact:
General Super Information
Damage Resistance: 90% [45%]
Base Duration: ? seconds, or ?% Super Drain per Second.

Throws out a homing knife, dealing 90 [?] impact damage and up to 171 [45?] radial damage to enemies within 3 meters on impact, teleporting to it afterwards.
Performs a wide whirling strike after teleporting, dealing 1,440 x 2 [300?] damage to enemies within 6 metres.
Consumes ?% Super Energy per knife thrown, up to 3 times per Super activation.

2370269389.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall
2370269389.description:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.

2370269390.name: Golden Gun: Marksman
2370269390.description:
Summon a precision flaming pistol that scorches and disintegrates targets with Solar Light.

Your Golden Gun deals massively increased precision damage, overpenetrates targets, and creates Orbs of Power on precision hits.

Benefits from being radiant.

2370269391.name: Silence and Squall
2370269391.description:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.

2835214897.name: Threaded Specter
2835214897.exact:
On Class Ability Usage:
Spawns a Strand Decoy. 

Decoy has 175 Construct HP and lasts for up to 12 seconds. Combatants are lured to attack it, and has 70% Damage Resist against Combatants. 
Allies and Caster deal 150% increased Ability and Weapon Damage towards it.
Decoy always counts as hostile and can be damaged by allies, enemies, and the caster. Does not activate any On-Kill effect.

Upon losing all HP or when an enemy is within ? metres:
 Deals up to 600 [60 Guardians | 121 Objects] damage in a ? metre radius.
Explosions triggered by enemies being near it spawn 2 Threadlings.

Passively applies 0.6x Class Ability Regeneration Speed while equipped.

2835214900.name: Stylish Executioner
2835214900.exact:
Killing Void-Debuffed Enemies grants Invisibility for 8+3.2 seconds, and Truesight for 4 seconds.

While invisible from activating Stylish Execution:
Melee Attacks deal 300% [20%] increased damage, weaken enemies for 5 [2.5] seconds, and have their Melee Lunge Range extended to ? metres.

Applies "Too Stylish" after Stylish Executioner is triggered, preventing additional Stylish Execution activations for 2 [12] seconds.

2835214901.name: Ascension
2835214901.exact:
While Airborne and having a Class Ability Charge:
[Air Move] consumes a Class Ability Charge to perform an upwards Arc Staff Twirl.
Triggers the effects of the equipped Class Ability on usage. 

Grants Amplified to the user and allies within 10 meters.
Deals up to 181 [?] damage, as well as Jolting enemies within 10 metres.
Aspect's Damage scales with Class Stat above 100, up to 65% [?%] at 200 Stat.

2835214902.name: Winter's Shroud
2835214902.exact:
Upon inflicting Slow to an enemy:
Grants 300% [150%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 3 seconds.

On Class Ability Usage:
Inflicts x60 [x40] Slow for 8+4? [1.5+0.5] seconds to enemies within 9 [8] metres.
Grants 50% Damage Resist against Combatants for 4? seconds.

2835214903.name: Gunpowder Gamble
2835214903.exact:
Kills charge up an Improvised Explosive. Readies at 6 Charges.
Weapon = 1 [2] | Ignition & Scorch = 3 [4] | Abilities = 4 | Super = 6

Replaces Grenade with an Ignition-on-a-Stick that causes an ignition that deals 50% increased damage upon being shot or after 3 seconds.
Shooting the dynamite increases its damage by 50% [5%], its radius by ?% to ? meters, and releases 9 homing submunitions, with each dealing up to 80 [?] Damage.

Incurs a 6 second cooldown after activating. Kills while on cooldown don't give charges.

74393640.name: Facet of Defiance
74393640.exact:
Finishers trigger an Elemental Detonation that deals 135 Super-Matching Elemental Damage and applies a Super-Matching Elemental Debuff to enemies within 7 meters.
Arc = Jolt | Solar = x40 Scorch | Void = Volatile 
Stasis = x? Slow for ? seconds | Strand = Sever

124726496.name: Facet of Blessing
124726496.exact:
Melee Kills begin health regeneration. 
Effect applies to allies within ? metres while Transcendent.

124726497.name: Facet of Command
124726497.exact:
Suppressing or Freezing an enemy refills the readied weapon and grants +20? Stability, +? Aim Assist, and +40 Airborne Effectiveness for 11 seconds. 
Incurs a 4 second cooldown before it can be reactivated.

Killing Frozen or Suppressed Enemies spawns a Stasis Shard or Void Breach respectively.

124726498.name: Facet of Purpose
124726498.exact:
Orbs of Power grant Elemental Buffs on pickup, based on the equipped Super.

Arc: x1 Bolt Charge.
Solar: Restoration x1 for 5 seconds.
Void: 22.5 HP Overshield for 5 seconds.
Stasis: x2 Frost Armor for 5 seconds.
Strand: Woven Mail for 5 seconds.

124726499.name: Facet of Ruin
124726499.exact:
Shattering enemies or destroying Crystals deals an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [9] damage in a 10 [8] metre radius. 
Falloff decreases damage dealt down to a minimum of 17 [4] damage at the maximum falloff distance.

Ignitions have 25% increased radius.

124726500.name: Facet of Mending
124726500.exact:
Grenade Ability Kills grant Cure x1.
Prismatic Grenade Kills grant Cure x2.

124726501.name: Facet of Honor
124726501.exact:
Picking up Elemental Pickups or destroying a Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment.

Ionic Traces, Firesprites, Void Breaches = 7.5% Light Energy 
Stasis Shards = 5% Darkness Energy | Tangles = 10% Darkness Energy

124726502.name: Facet of Sacrifice
124726502.exact: Ability Kills while affected by an Arc, Solar, or Void Elemental Buff grant an additional 1% [?%] Darkness Transcendence Energy.

124726503.name: Facet of Bravery
124726503.exact:
Grenade Kills grant Volatile Rounds to Void Weapons for 11.25 [7.5] seconds.

Powered Melee Kills grant Unraveling Rounds to Strand Weapons for 11.25 [7.5] seconds.

124726504.name: Facet of Dominance
124726504.exact:
Void Grenade Ability Damage inflicts Weaken for 6 [?] seconds.

Arc Grenade Ability Damage inflicts Jolt.
Arc Soul has a 4 second cooldown before being able to inflict Jolt again.

124726505.name: Facet of Awakening
124726505.exact:
Killing 3 enemies with Elemental Damage within 6 seconds of each, or a Super Kill spawns an Element-Matching Elemental Pickup.
Elemental Pickup is determined by the Damage Type of the final kill.

Incurs a 5 second cooldown between spawning the same Non-Tangle Elemental Pickups.
Kills with the element of the spawned pickup while the cooldown is active do not count towards spawning another Elemental Pickup.

2626922114.name: Facet of Balance
2626922114.exact:
Killing 3 enemies within 3 seconds of each with Light Damage grants 10% Melee Energy.

Killing 3 enemies within 3 seconds of each with Dark Damage grants 10% Grenade Energy.

2626922115.name: Facet of Justice
2626922115.exact: Ability Kills while Transcendent trigger an explosion that deals up to 130 [?] Ability-Matching damage over ? meters

2626922120.name: Facet of Protection
2626922120.exact:
While within 15 metres of 3 enemies:
15% [?%] Damage Resist.
In-Game Description is erroneous, the effect does NOT become increased while Transcendent. 
Instead, the 15% DR from Protection stacks with Transcendence's 20%, totalling 32% DR.

2626922121.name: Facet of Grace
2626922121.exact:
Kinetic Weapon Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Transcendence energy.

Super Kills grant an additional 2% [?%] Transcendence Energy to the user and allies within ? metres.

2626922122.name: Facet of Hope
2626922122.exact:
Grants Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate based on the amount of active Elemental Buffs.
x1 = 40% | x2 = 60%

2626922123.name: Facet of Solitude
2626922123.exact:
Upon scoring a Magazine-Based amount of Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each:
The next damage instance from any source within 3 seconds will emit a Severing Burst.
Sever Burst inflicts Sever to enemies within 3 metres. Radius is increased to 6 meters while Transcendent.
Incurs a 4 second cooldown upon Severing. Precision Hits during the cooldown will not be counted.

Precision hits required to prepare the Severing Burst:
20% of Magazine + 1, rounded down.
Bows: 2 hits
The Precision Hit that prepares the Severing Burst can't trigger the effect through simultaneous damage instances. Trinity Ghoul and the Explosive Payload perk, for example.

2626922124.name: Facet of Courage
2626922124.exact:
Against enemies inflicted with Stasis or Strand Elemental Debuffs:
Light Abilities deal 10% increased damage.
Light Powered Melee Abilities deal 50% [10%] increased damage.

2626922125.name: Facet of Devotion
2626922125.exact:
Killing enemies affected by Stasis or Strand Elemental Debuffs grants additional Light Transcendence Energy.
Rank-and-File = 1% | Elites = 3% | Minibosses+ = 5% | Guardians = ?%

2626922126.name: Facet of Dawn
2626922126.exact:
Powered Melee Hits grant Radiant for 5 seconds.

Powered Melee Kills grant Radiant for 5 seconds to the user and allies within ? metres.

2626922127.name: Facet of Generosity
2626922127.exact:
Kills while Transcendent progress a counter that spawns Orbs of Power that grant 7.15% Super Energy for allies at specific thresholds.
Up to a maximum of 4 Orbs of Power can be spawned per Transcendence activation.

Tier 1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 15% | T3 = 20% | T4 = 34% | Minibosses = 40% | Bosses = 50% | Guardians = ?%
Orbs of Power are spawned at the 30% (1st) | 50% (2nd) | 70% (3rd) | 100% (4th) thresholds.

426473316.name: Marksman's Dodge
426473316.description: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.
426473316.exact:
Performs an evasive maneuver that reloads all weapons and picks up Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

426473317.name: Gambler's Dodge
426473317.description: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.
426473317.exact:
Performs a deft tumble that grants 1% [0.35%] Melee Ability Energy per Melee Stat, up to 100% [35%] Melee Ability Energy at 100 Melee Stat.
Dodging within 15 meters of an enemy doubles the Ability Energy gained. No Chunk or Stat Scalar.
Removes Combatant Projectile Tracking, as well as Aim Assist against Guardians during the Dodge Animation.

95544328.name: Triple Jump
95544328.description: While airborne, sustain your air control with a second or third jump.

95544329.name: Blink
95544329.description: Jump while airborne to teleport a short distance.

95544330.name: High Jump
95544330.description: While airborne, jump a second time to reach greater heights.

95544331.name: Strafe Jump
95544331.description: While airborne, jump a second time with strong directional control.

2716335210.name: Disorienting Blow
2716335210.description: Striking a target with this melee ability blinds them, amplifies you, and grants you a moderate amount of Bolt Charge.
2716335210.exact:
Deals 162 [?] Impact Damage and up to 976 [?] Splash Damage, down to ?% damage over 7 meters.
Inflicts Blind for 8.5 seconds to enemies within 9.6 meters on hit.

Grants Amplified and x2 Bolt Charge on hit.

2716335211.name: Combination Blow
2716335211.description:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.
2716335211.exact:
Upon scoring a Melee Kill:
Grants 100% Class Ability, restores 100 Health, and grants a stack of Combination Blow for 20 seconds, up to 3 stacks.
Basic Melee Attacks count as Arc-Infused Melee Damage while Combination Blow is active.
70 Class Stat is required for a full Gambler's Dodge refund.

Combination Blow x1 | 133% [23%] Increased Melee Damage. Melee Kills restore 80 HP.
Combination Blow x2 | 266% [51.3%] Increased Melee Damage. Melee Kills restore 60 HP.
Combination Blow x3 | 400% [86%] Increased Melee Damage. Melee Kills restore 40 HP.

146194908.name: Skip Grenade
146194908.description: A grenade that splits upon impact, creating multiple projectiles that seek targets.
146194908.exact:
Medium Trajectory | Seekers

Splits on impact, releasing 4 seekers that chase after enemies.

Seekers begin chasing enemies that come within 6 metres of them, exploding after dealing damage, or self-destructing after ~2 seconds if their velocity is low.

Each projectile deals 24 [4] impact damage twice, then explodes for up to 90 [15] damage.
Deals up to 552 [92] damage with all 4 seekers.

1582574009.name: Arcbolt Grenade
1582574009.description: A grenade that chains bolts of lightning to nearby targets.

Heavy Trajectory | Scan

Scans and targets the closest enemy in Line of Sight within 12 meters upon impact, releasing Arc Lightning towards them after 1 second.

Arc Lightning deals 521 [85] damage.

1713935764.name: Pulse Grenade
1713935764.description: A grenade that periodically damages targets within its explosion radius.
1713935764.exact:
Medium Trajectory

Detonates on impact, dealing up to 156 [50] damage in a 6 meter radius.

Periodically pulses every 0.7 seconds, dealing up to 249 [80] damage in a 6 meter radius an additional 5+2 times.
Can deal up to a total of 1,245 [1,743] [530 [690]] damage.

2481624867.name: Storm Grenade
2481624867.description: A grenade that calls down a focused lightning storm.
2481624867.exact:
Medium Trajectory

Calls down a focused strike on impact which hits after 0.85 seconds, dealing up to 440 [70] damage in a 7 meter radius.

After 0.6 seconds of the initial strike:
Calls down a barrage of bolts in a X pattern over 7 meters, dealing up to 311 [50] damage.
Spark of Magnitude: Calls down a second barrage of bolts in an + pattern over 7 meters, dealing up to 311 [50] damage.
Combatants can only be damaged once per barrage, up to a maximum of 751 [1062] damage.
Guardians can only be hurt once by the barrage of bolts, regardless of pattern, for a maximum of 120 damage.

2909720723.name: Flashbang Grenade
2909720723.description: An explosive grenade that damages and blinds nearby targets.
2909720723.exact:
Medium Trajectory

Explodes after its speed is sufficiently reduced. Has a brief delay before it can explode.

Explosion deals up to 684 [120] damage, down to 0% damage over a 7.5 meter radius, and inflicts blind to enemies within 10 meters for up to 5 [3] seconds.
The user is immune to self-blind.

2994412667.name: Lightning Grenade
2994412667.description: A grenade that sticks to any surface and emits bolts of lightning.
2994412667.exact:
Medium Trajectory | Wall-Mounted

Attaches to surfaces and enemies, projecting a laser for 1 second before triggering.

Emits a Lightning Bolt every 1.67 seconds, up to a maximum of 4+1 times.
Lightning Bolts deal 373 [120] damage, up to a total of 1492 [1865] [480 [600]] damage.

4198689901.name: Flux Grenade
4198689901.description: An explosive grenade that attaches to targets.
4198689901.exact:
Almost Straight Trajectory | Slight Projectile Tracking | Sticky

Attaches to enemies or surfaces, exploding after 1.7 seconds.

Explosion deals up to 901 [150] damage, down to 0% damage over a 6 meter radius on detonation.
Sticking an enemy increases explosion damage by 66.7% to 1,500 [250] damage.

3769507632.name: Gathering Storm
3769507632.description:
Hurl your Arc Staff forward, embedding it into surfaces or large targets and jolting nearby targets.

After a short time, a devastating lightning bolt strikes the staff, overcharging it with Arc energy. While overcharged, your staff discharges lightning at nearby foes.
3769507632.exact:

Damage Resistance: 90% [49%]

Hurls forward an Arc Staff that explodes and embeds itself on whatever it hits on impact.
Deals 544 [300] damage and inflicts jolt on impact. Explosion deals up to 608 [?] damage in a 10 meter radius.

After 2 seconds, the Arc Staff gets struck by a lightning strike, dealing up to 1350 [500] damage in a 10 meter radius.

After 1.2 seconds of being struck by lightning, the Staff emits a damaging field, dealing 446 [60] damage every 0.7 seconds in a 10 meter radius for 8 seconds.

3769507633.name: Arc Staff
3769507633.description:
Form a staff of pure Arc energy and acrobatically take out your foes.

[Block] : Hold to deflect incoming projectiles with your Arc staff.

Deflecting a projectile grants you a stack of Bolt Charge.

Heavy attack combos and airborne heavy slams blind targets.

Deals 1,264 [?] damage and inflicts blind over 7 meters away

200% Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate, +50 Reload Speed, and 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier.
66% [32%] Damage Resist during Dodge Animation.

4194622037.exact:
Scoring a Jolted Enemy Kill grants x1 Bolt Charge.
Does not stack alongside Dielectric's x1 Bolt Charge.

While Sliding:
[Melee Ability] performs an uppercut, launching an Arc Wave along the ground up to 22 metres away, dealing 739 [125] damage and inflicting Jolt.
Grants 75% Damage Resist against Combatants for 4? seconds after usage. Unable to use during slide if user shoots.
Can trigger Combination Blow effects, and benefits from its damage increase. Does not interact with Disorienting Blow.

4194622038.name: Lethal Current
4194622038.exact:
Direct Melee Hits on Jolted Enemies inflict Blind.

Melee Lunge Distance is increased to 7 metres.

Aspect's Damage scales with Class Stat above 100, up to 65% [?%] at 200 Stat.

1727069360.exact:
After 1.25 seconds of sprinting, while maintaining both sprint and a movement speed of at least 5m/s:
150% [75%] Additional Base Class Ability Regeneration Rate.
Deactivates once Class Ability has at least 1 charge readied.

1727069361.name: Spark of Frequency
1727069361.exact:
Upon scoring a Melee Hit:
+15 Stability, +50 Reload Speed, and 0.8x Reload Duration Multiplier for 5.25 seconds.

While Amplified:
(almost) All sources of Bolt Charge now grant an additional stack.
In-game tooltip mentions increasing the fragment's effects, which is not true, at least for the Reload Speed bonuses.

1727069362.name: Spark of Discharge
1727069362.exact:
Arc Weapon Kills progress a counter that spawns an Ionic Trace upon reaching 100%.
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite = 67% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 67%

Picking up Ionic Traces grants x1 Bolt Charge.

1727069363.name: Spark of Ions

Killing Jolted Enemies, or scoring a Bolt Charge Kill creates an Ionic Trace.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown between Ionic Traces spawns.

1727069364.name: Spark of Shock

Arc Grenades inflict Jolt on hit.

25% [10%] Damage Resist.
